alert_templates.description_template: Medical emergency reported in {zone}. Fan collapsed near {section}. First responders requested immediately.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Dispatch medical team. Clear path from First Aid to {zone}. Alert nearest gate staff.

alert_templates.description_template: Heat exhaustion case in {zone}, Section {section}. Fan conscious but dizzy.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Send water and cooling supplies. Guide fan to nearest cooling station or First Aid.

alert_templates.description_template: Crowd density at {gate} exceeds safe threshold. Current queue time: {queue_time} minutes. Risk of crush situation.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Redirect incoming fans to alternate gates. Deploy crowd-control barriers. Announce alternate entry via PA.

alert_templates.description_template: Concourse in {zone} experiencing heavy foot traffic. Movement speed below 0.5 m/s.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Open overflow corridors. Position staff at choke points. Consider one-way flow in concourse.

alert_templates.description_template: Lost child reported in {zone}. Description: approximately {age} years old, wearing {clothing}. Last seen near {section}.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Activate Code Adam. Lock down nearest exits. Broadcast description on staff radios. Check Family Zone and child wristband station.

alert_templates.description_template: Unattended bag found near {section} in {zone}. Area has been cordoned off by nearby fans.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Send security team immediately. Clear 30m radius. Do not touch the item. Contact bomb disposal if not claimed in 5 minutes.

alert_templates.description_template: Altercation between fans in {zone}, Section {section}. Verbal dispute escalating.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Deploy security personnel. Separate individuals. Offer de-escalation. Consider ejection if necessary.

alert_templates.description_template: Elevator malfunction at {zone}. Elevator stuck between levels 1 and 2. {occupants} people inside.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Contact maintenance immediately. Communicate with occupants via intercom. Redirect wheelchair users to alternate routes.

alert_templates.description_template: Restroom flooding in {zone} near Section {section}. Two stalls out of order.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Send maintenance crew. Place wet floor signs. Direct fans to nearest alternate restrooms.

alert_templates.description_template: Severe thunderstorm warning issued for stadium area. Expected arrival in {minutes} minutes. Lightning risk.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Activate weather protocol. Prepare to halt match. Direct fans to covered areas. Secure outdoor equipment.

alert_templates.description_template: Temperature exceeding 35°C (95°F). Heat advisory in effect for outdoor zones.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Activate misting stations. Distribute free water at all gates. Increase cooling station staffing.

alert_templates.description_template: Wheelchair ramp at {gate} blocked by crowd gathering. Wheelchair users unable to enter.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Clear ramp immediately. Deploy staff to maintain clear path. Set up temporary barriers to protect wheelchair lane.

alert_templates.description_template: VIP delegation arriving at VIP Gate in {minutes} minutes. {count} guests with security detail.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Prepare VIP entrance. Brief security team. Ensure VIP Lounge is ready.

alert_templates.description_template: Smoke detected in {zone} kitchen area near Section {section}. Fire alarm triggered.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Evacuate immediate area. Deploy fire team. Do NOT use elevators. Activate sprinkler system if needed.

alert_templates.description_template: Power flickering in {zone}. Backup generators on standby.
alert_templates.recommended_action: Monitor situation. Prepare backup lighting. Alert IT team for scoreboard/display systems.
